source.surface: page body, AI rewrite proposed inline with a disposition menu open
source.attribution: Flow curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screens.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: a plain menu row with a monochrome check glyph and a text label; no fill, no border, no colour
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: a plain menu row of identical construction labelled Discard, with a monochrome cross glyph, plus a keyboard-shortcut hint
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the outgoing phrase is struck through in grey and the incoming phrase is set in ordinary body colour; no tint band, no coloured card
decisionColour.verdict: Neither disposition carries any colour. Accept and Discard are visually identical rows differentiated only by their glyph and their label, so the surface expresses no preference between them.

facts.subject: disposition-menu
facts.locatorDescription: flow position 2, the dropdown below the AI input, reading Accept / Discard / Insert below / Try again; a fifth row "Get Notion AI" is a promotion, not a disposition

facts.subject: accept-and-discard-rows
facts.value: glyph and label only; identical background, identical type, identical row height, no fill on either
facts.locatorDescription: flow position 2, the first two rows of the dropdown

facts.subject: discard-row
facts.value: a right-aligned keyboard-shortcut hint reading Escape
facts.locatorDescription: flow position 2, the row labelled "Discard", far right of the row

facts.subject: accept-row
facts.value: no keyboard-shortcut hint, so the cheap-to-press shortcut is bound to the reversible disposition and not to the committing one
facts.locatorDescription: flow position 2, compare the right edge of the "Accept" row against the right edge of the "Discard" row
